# Lore Encyclopedia

## World: Chronos

### Creation Myth

The world was born from the Dream of the Eternal - a consciousness that slept before time itself. When it woke, it dreamed into existence the First Era.

### Eras

| Era | Description | Notable |
|-----|-------------|---------|
| First | Divine creation | The Eternal sleeps |
| Second | Mortal rise | First kingdoms |
| Third | Magic bloom | Mage wars |
| Fourth | Empire | Current era |

## Factions

### The Verdant Circle

- Nature magic practitioners
- Based in Deep Forest
- Goal: Balance with nature

### Iron Syndicate

- Merchants and craftsmen
- Based in cities
- Goal: Prosperity

### The Veiled Order

- Scholars and seers
- Ancient libraries
- Goal: Knowledge

### The Shadow Court

- Unknown agenda
- Hidden presence
- Goal: ???

## Geography

### Continents

- **Verdantis** - Forest realm
- **Ironreach** - Mountain dwarves
- **Sunken Isle** - Lost magic

### Notable Locations

| Location | Type | Faction |
|----------|------|---------|
| Oakhaven | Capital | Verdant |
| Ironhold | Fortress | Syndicate |
| Whisper Keep | Ruins | Veiled |

## Magic System

### Schools

- Verdant (nature)
- Arcane (pure)
- Shadow (void)
- Divine (celestial)

### Principles

- Energy flows
- Balance required
- Intent matters
